hero.badge: Digital Public Good for Indian Smallholders
hero.headline: Your farm's intelligent AI advisor.
hero.subheadline: AgriSahayak combines real-time satellite weather telemetry, verified ICAR soil profiles, and multimodal Gemini AI to empower smallholder farmers across India.

onboarding.featureTitle: Engineered for Grounded Rural Agricultural Impact
onboarding.featureSubtitle: AgriSahayak integrates verified agricultural domain datasets with state-of-the-art AI.
onboarding.feature1Desc: Real regional soil profiles and organic carbon metrics mapped dynamically across all 780 districts.
onboarding.feature2Desc: Natural conversational advisory in 9 Indian languages with real-time speech output.
onboarding.feature3Desc: Computer vision diagnosis analyzing leaf symptoms, organic cures, and chemical alternatives.
onboarding.feature4Desc: Decentralized outbreak intelligence alerting adjacent farming communities in real time.

diagnosis.title: Multimodal Crop Pathology
diagnosis.subtitle: Upload or capture a photo of affected leaves, stems, or fruits for instant disease detection, organic treatments, and community alerts.
diagnosis.uploadSubtitle: Supports JPG, PNG photos up to 10MB. Clear leaf close-ups provide the most accurate diagnosis.
diagnosis.demoSamples: Or choose from verified ICAR test samples:
diagnosis.diagnosingDetail: Scanning lesions, leaf discolouration, and microbial symptoms with Gemini AI...
diagnosis.communityAlertDetail: This anonymized diagnosis has been relayed to the community early-warning radar for {{district}}.

dashboard.title: Community Disease Outbreak Radar
dashboard.subtitle: Aggregated, anonymized disease reports creating a real-time biosecurity shield across Indian farming districts.

scales.title: How AgriSahayak Scales as a Digital Public Good
scales.subtitle: AgriSahayak is engineered on open-source specifications designed to integrate state ministries, cooperative networks, and individual smallholder nodes across India into a shared predictive diagnostic grid.
scales.pillar1Desc: Soil profiles, satellite-derived NDVI vegetation, and diagnostic outputs utilize standardized, lightweight JSON definitions. Any state portal or NGO can leverage this payload.
scales.pillar1Tag: Standardized under Indian Digital Agriculture guidelines
scales.pillar2Desc: Designed to run efficiently on low-bandwidth rural 2G/4G connectivity, with audio synthesis and offline fallback data caching.
scales.pillar2Tag: Sub-second response over rural mobile networks
scales.pillar3Desc: All farmer queries are non-custodial and privacy-preserving. Disease reports are anonymized with geographic jittering to protect landholdings.
scales.pillar3Tag: Adheres to DPDP Act (Digital Personal Data Protection)
scales.footerQuote: Empowering every Indian Kisan with sovereign, localized, and science-grounded artificial intelligence.

footer.dpgStatement: AgriSahayak is an open digital public good architecture built for Indian agriculture.
footer.allRights: Designed for all 28 States & 8 Union Territories of India.
